name: BCYF Camp Joy
operator_name: Boston Centers for Youth and Families
description_short: A city-run, four-week, full-day summer camp for Boston residents with disabilities ages 3-15 and their siblings ages 3-7, run by Boston Centers for Youth & Families. Activities range from group games to gym time and arts and crafts. It includes breakfast, lunch, door-to-door transportation and a licensed nurse at each site.
special_needs_notes: Open only to Boston residents with disabilities ages 3-15 (proof of residency required). Siblings ages 3-7 may also attend. Campers must be able to take part at a ratio of 4 participants to 1 staff member. Each site has a licensed nurse, and all staff are professionally trained and CPR certified. Slots are first come, first served, and only completed applications are accepted.
